svg.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
svg.desc: A batched GPU centroidal MPC solver supplies predictive landmarks for training rewards. RL learns whole-body behavior from this guidance. Parallel MPC computation across horizons and environments enables training-time model-based guidance. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
